sentence: This project builds a device that checks how well a patient's blood cells kill pathogens using a drop of whole blood.
This project builds software that uses machine learning to analyze single-cell multi-omics data.
This project studies configuration spaces, which collect the possible positions of agents in an environment where no two agents collide, using algebraic topology.
This project upgrades the network and cybersecurity resources at a university to protect sensitive data and support teaching and research.
This project studies how multiple rotating motors on the bacterial surface work together to drive a protein-based conveyor belt.
This project continues a program that promotes cybersecurity education and research at a university.
This project builds analog quantum hardware and uses it to run simulations in quantum chemistry, condensed matter physics and nuclear physics.
This project designs efficient unified memory techniques for graphics processing units by studying the patterns of massively parallel memory accesses.
This project builds a sequencing method that finds when and where RNA modifications are added and removed in tomato plants under heat stress.
This project develops a fast and sensitive method to detect hazardous volatile organic compounds in recycled plastics.
This project uses ultracold neutral atoms and trapped ions to simulate and study quantum many-body systems.
This project builds hands-on learning pathways in semiconductor quantum technologies.
This project builds an artificial intelligence framework that learns material parameters of complex alloys from microstructure images.
This project gets an instrument called a mass photometer that measures molecular masses in solution to study how proteins form complexes.
